description: Output schema for the command parser. Every output is one JSON object with exactly these four keys.

slots.date: A day or date, for example: today, saturday, the month of may
slots.time: A clock time or time expression, for example: seven am, after five hours
slots.place: A city or location, for example: london, los angeles

slot_rules: A slot value is copied exactly as it appears in the command. It is not converted (seven am is not changed to 07:00).
A slot value is the shortest phrase that carries the meaning, without words such as at, on, in or for.
A slot the command does not mention is null. Values must never be invented.
